title: Genealogist in Residence Program-Historic Lewes | Cape Gazette
text:
Discover your family history at the Lewes History Museum on the first Saturday of each month, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., with the Genealogist in Residence program. Friendly, experienced genealogists from the Sussex County Genealogical Society are on hand to help bring your research to life. Learn more at https://www.historiclewes.org/events.
